description.en: Anurognathus ammoni inspired living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Whole Anurognathus: Bennett primary author whole articulated description and Witton2015 Fig5 C/D actually viewed. Broad short tall head, large anterolateral eyes, compact body, short tail and three decreasing wingfinger phalanges. Relaxed quadrupedal crouch and partially folded ankle-attached membranes are artistic; glenoid and exact membrane attachment unknown. No Jeholopterus geometry reuse. Colors and nominal scale artistic.
